comment: houdini-bridge-mcp startup package. Adds the sibling 'houdini-bridge-mcp' plugin folder to HOUDINI_PATH so its scripts/456.py runs at GUI startup and auto-arms the in-Houdini executor from ~/.houdini-bridge-mcp/arm.json. Location-independent: $HOUDINI_PACKAGE_PATH resolves to the directory containing THIS package file, so no absolute paths or usernames are baked in.
